_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The mobile drawer does not open while a diff viewer modal is shown. The phone's screen is 393x851. The page has synthetic touch gestures, run with eval: "window.__drawerSwipe(selector, x1, y1, x2, y2)" puts one finger down at viewport point x1,y1 on the first element matching selector, moves it to x2,y2 and lifts it; "window.__drawerDrag(selector, points, ending, secondFinger, modalAtEnd)" puts a finger down at the first [x, y] of points and moves it through the rest (with a second finger beside it when secondFinger is true), then ends with ending ("touchend" or "touchcancel"); when modalAtEnd is true a modal (".command-palette-overlay" with aria-modal) appears just before the release and goes after it. __drawerDrag returns the computed styles ({className, transform, translate, opacity}) of every ".drawer, .backdrop, .toc-drawer, .toc-drawer-scrim" element just before the release, and keeps them in window.__drawerDragStyles. Run each gesture with a single eval, without expect; wait for its target to exist first. "Open" means the drawer (".drawer") has the class "open"; "closed" that it exists without it (eval "document.querySelector('.drawer').classList.contains('open')" with no guard, so that a missing drawer fails). The test harness has already stubbed the server's conversation list to one conversation, "first", in /tmp, and cut off its live update stream; there is nothing to set up or check about that. Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is {"role": "button", "name": "X", "exact": true}, with a "selector" to scope it when it is a row's, a menu's or a group's; but "there is no button X" counts {"role": "button", "name": "X"} without exact, so that a name containing X counts too. Texts that "are exactly [...]" are checked with assert_texts. "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. 1. Navigate to /new. 2. The message input (data-testid "message-input") should be visible (the shortcut is the app's; a key pressed before it has mounted is lost). 3. Without clicking or focusing anything first, press "D" with modifiers "Control+Shift". 4. ".diff-viewer-overlay" should be visible. 5. Swipe ".diff-viewer-header" from 180,100 to 256,104. 6. The drawer is closed.
